name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise Shopping Street
description: Tokyo's oldest and most famous temple, with a dramatic gate and bustling market street.

name: Shibuya Crossing & Scramble Square
description: The world's busiest pedestrian crossing — an iconic Tokyo experience, especially at night.

name: Akihabara Electric Town
description: The global epicenter of anime, manga, and electronics culture. Multi-floor arcades, figurine shops, and maid cafes.

name: teamLab Borderless Digital Art
description: Immersive digital art museum where light, color, and sound create an otherworldly environment.

name: Tsukiji Outer Market Breakfast
description: Sample sushi, tamagoyaki, and fresh oysters at legendary market stalls. Go early for the best selection.

name: Shinjuku Kabukicho Nightlife
description: Tokyo's most vibrant entertainment district — neon-lit izakayas, karaoke bars, and the famous Golden Gai alleys.

name: Harajuku Takeshita Street & Meiji Shrine
description: From Meiji Shrine's forest tranquility to Harajuku's wild street fashion, this area captures Tokyo's extremes.

name: Tokyo Tower & Roppongi Hills
description: Iconic red-and-white tower with panoramic views. Nearby Roppongi Hills has world-class restaurants and galleries.

name: Robot Restaurant Show
description: Outrageous LED-and-robot dinner theater show in Shinjuku. Unmistakably over-the-top Tokyo.

name: Ueno Park & Museums
description: Vast park hosting Tokyo National Museum, Zoo, street performers, and stunning cherry blossom spots.

name: Fushimi Inari Taisha — Thousand Torii Gates
description: Trek through thousands of vermillion torii gates winding up a sacred mountain. Most magical at dawn or dusk.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Monkey Park
description: Walk through towering bamboo stalks, cross the iconic Togetsukyo Bridge, and observe wild monkeys.

name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
description: One of Japan's most photographed buildings — a Zen temple covered in gold leaf, reflected in a mirror pond.

name: Gion District Evening Stroll
description: Kyoto's historic geisha district. Spot maiko in kimono along cobblestone Hanamikoji Street at dusk.

name: Tea Ceremony Experience
description: Participate in a traditional matcha tea ceremony in a 400-year-old townhouse.

name: Nishiki Market — 'Kyoto's Kitchen'
description: A narrow 5-block covered market with 100+ vendors selling pickles, tofu, fresh fish, and local delicacies.

name: Dotonbori Canal & Street Food Tour
description: Osaka's neon-lit entertainment hub. Eat takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and kushikatsu along the famous canal.

name: Universal Studios Japan
description: World-class theme park with Harry Potter, Super Nintendo World, and Jujutsu Kaisen attractions.

name: Osaka Castle & Castle Park
description: Iconic 16th-century castle with a museum inside and beautiful surrounding moat and gardens.

name: Kuromon Ichiba Market
description: 650-meter covered market nicknamed 'Osaka's Kitchen' — fresh seafood, wagyu beef, and street food.

name: Peace Memorial Museum & Park
description: Deeply moving museum documenting the 1945 atomic bombing and Hiroshima's transformation into a peace city.

name: Miyajima Island & Floating Torii
description: Ferry to sacred Miyajima Island to see the iconic floating torii gate, hike Mt. Misen, and meet friendly deer.

name: Nara Deer Park & Todai-ji
description: Feed wild deer, then enter Japan's largest wooden structure housing a 15-meter bronze Buddha statue.

name: Ryokan Stay & Onsen
description: Stay in a traditional Japanese inn with kaiseki dinner, futon bedding, and private hot spring baths.

name: Mt. Fuji Viewing & Lake Ashi Cruise
description: Take the Hakone Ropeway over volcanic Owakudani and cruise Lake Ashi on a pirate ship with Fuji views.

name: Kenroku-en Garden
description: One of Japan's three great gardens — featuring streams, ponds, bridges, and immaculate seasonal plantings.

name: Higashi Chaya Geisha District
description: Beautifully preserved 19th-century geisha quarter with tea houses, gold-leaf workshops, and craft shops.

name: Yatai Street Food Stalls
description: Sit at one of Fukuoka's iconic outdoor food stalls along the river for tonkotsu ramen, yakitori, and local sake.

name: Sapporo Beer Museum & Gardens
description: Tour Japan's oldest brewery, learn the history of Sapporo Beer, and sample fresh draft in the beer hall.

name: Kerama Islands Diving & Snorkeling
description: Day trip to the Kerama Islands for world-class visibility snorkeling with manta rays and sea turtles.

name: Tosho-gu Shrine Complex
description: Extraordinarily elaborate shrine dedicated to Tokugawa Ieyasu, surrounded by massive cedar forest.

name: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry
description: Fascinating museum tracing Toyota's evolution from loom manufacturer to automotive giant.
